product_one_liner.value: Advocate standardizes commercial insurance policies and benchmarks coverage and pricing to help brokers, loan servicers, insurers, and property owners identify coverage gaps and make placement and renewal decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes standardizing policy data, benchmarking it against market transactions, and supporting coverage and renewal decisions; it explicitly identifies the customer groups used in the summary. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists an Enterprise plan with custom pricing, which qualifies even without a numeric price. Source: https://advocate.app/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: KeyBank and Greystone both appear on the homepage customer logo wall. Source: https://advocate.app/ | named_customers.0: KeyBank appears on the homepage customer logo wall. Source: https://advocate.app/ | named_customers.1: Greystone appears on the homepage customer logo wall. Source: https://advocate.app/

employee_band.notes: The reported count of 74 maps to the 51-100 band. Profile-based employee counts may not equal exact payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly states that it is headquartered in New York City. Sources: https://www.advocate.app/about and https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

founded_year.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile explicitly lists 2020 as its founding year. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains one company funding/launch post. The separate Labs index links a single WIM research article, so the required two engineering-authored technical posts are not established. Sources: https://www.advocate.app/blog and https://www.advocate.app/labs

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation links multiple articles, including authentication, query parameters and a case-creation guide. Source: https://docs.advocate.app/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete five-role board lists Platform Engineer, two Product Engineer roles, Client Solutions Manager and Insurance Consultant. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; AI-related duties alone do not qualify. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/en-GB/advocate-technologies-inc/jobs

model_provider.notes: The security page explicitly says inference runs with providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI under enterprise agreements. Source: https://www.advocate.app/security

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the five listed openings is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive role. The Client Solutions Manager opening does not meet the specified title criteria. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/en-GB/advocate-technologies-inc/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: The dated announcement states that Advocate publicly launched on August 4, 2026, within the six-month window. Source: https://www.advocate.app/blog/advocate-raises-18-million-commercial-insurance-benchmarks

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: the about page does not provide a complete named leadership roster with start dates, and the executive profiles reviewed did not establish a dated qualifying appointment or departure within the window. Source/update dates were not treated as transition dates. Sources reviewed: https://www.advocate.app/about and https://people.equilar.com/bio/org/advocate-technologies-inc/10042773

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable Platform Engineer and Product Engineer postings and public documentation name no CRM or sales/marketing systems. The cited Platform Engineer responsibilities discuss integrations and internal tooling without identifying a qualifying system. This is an empty observed signal, not a claim that the company uses no CRM.
